title: Reciprocal convex callback bit filter
summary: Recovered VA 0x427110, RVA 0x27110: thiscall bool method tests this.mask & other.group, then this.group & other.mask, using unsigned 16-bit fields at +6 and +4. It writes no memory. The +0 word remains opaque. Direct original disassembly agrees with accepted assembly; references in two original vtables establish virtual use but exact dynamic callers remain unresolved.
test_description: GCC i386 direct oracle comparison at original VA using a thiscall bool declaration: 10000 edge-mask combinations, all 65536 single-bit quadruples, and 10000 deterministic mixed-mask cases. Check expected reciprocal intersections, self-aliasing, and all bytes of both guarded object prefixes and adjacent sentinel fields after calls. No imports, TLS, allocations or OS services required.
known_limits: Only the observed eight-byte prefix is modeled; full class identity, size, and exact dynamic callers are unresolved. Group and mask are semantic names.
Valid readable pointers required, as in original; invalid-pointer faults are not exercised. Upper EAX bits are unspecified for the bool return and are not compared.
No byte matching claimed; complete collision processing and neighboring callbacks are outside scope.
